content.title: Emblem World Loop | Enter the Mark, Traverse Its World, Return to Form
content.summary: First, a simple logo is used as a portal and geometric rule to enter a three-dimensional world composed of its shape, color and direction; after passing through the environment, role and a scale jump, all structures must be traced back to the same logo.

quick_start.input_format: Stability sign + three-dimensional world expansion + central character action + one scale jump + accurate recycling of the same sign
quick_start.recommended_input: An original copper compass rose only rotates once and locks, and the four petals unfold into a solid waterway, and the camera penetrates into the cream-colored glass greenhouse; the seed storage automatic machine turns the valve once, and the water veins are transmitted to four channels at the same time, and the compass structure can still be read on the ground; the established tower leaves, skeleton, valve block and waterway are folded inward in sequence, accurately reconstructing the same copper compass rose from the opening scene, no new copywriting appears
required_anchors: Begin with one compact emblem that clearly defines geometry, palette and direction.
Expand the emblem into a navigable environment using repeated versions of its own components.
Use one major scale change to gather the environment into a simplified global form.
End by rebuilding and holding the same opening emblem from visible world components.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: First, a simple logo is used as a portal and geometric rule to enter a three-dimensional world composed of its shape, color and direction; after passing through the environment, role and a scale jump, all structures must be traced back to the same logo.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Open on one compact emblem whose geometry, palette and directional cue become the construction rules of an inhabitable world. Move through at least two spatial proofs, include one readable occupant or functional checkpoint, then perform one large scale change that gathers the world's repeated geometry. Reconstruct the same opening emblem from those visible components and hold it as the terminal state.

invariants.rule: Begin with one compact emblem that clearly defines geometry, palette and direction.
invariants.ablation_failure: A generic abstract opening cannot govern the later world.

invariants.rule: Expand the emblem into a navigable environment using repeated versions of its own components.
invariants.purpose: Proves world construction rather than a logo cutaway.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unrelated buildings and colors break lineage.

invariants.rule: Include one readable inhabitant or functional checkpoint inside the expanded world.
invariants.purpose: Gives the journey a concrete spatial stop.
invariants.ablation_failure: Pure fly-through spectacle lacks an interior proof.

invariants.rule: Use one major scale change to gather the environment into a simplified global form.
invariants.purpose: Prepares a causal return to the origin.
invariants.ablation_failure: A random zoom-out does not explain reconstruction.

invariants.rule: End by rebuilding and holding the same opening emblem from visible world components.
invariants.ablation_failure: A new logo or unrelated title card discards the accumulated world.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: black-white-yellow low-poly city and pipe network
the faceted white villain on a red sofa
yellow ribbons around a black-white tower
the source exact triangle-city-triangle shot sequence

instantiations.concept: A copper compass-rose emblem unfolds into an original clockwork greenhouse. The camera follows four radial water channels to a seed-keeper automaton, rises along a helical weather tower, then blades, pipes and glass ribs fold back into the identical compass rose.
instantiations.prompt_seed: A copper compass-rose emblem unfolds into an original clockwork greenhouse. The camera follows four radial water channels to a seed-keeper automaton, rises along a helical weather tower, then blades, pipes and glass ribs fold back into the identical compass rose.

instantiations.concept: A blue ink fish mark opens into a stop-motion paper harbor. Follow fin-shaped piers and current arrows to a lighthouse puppet, pull outward until the harbor becomes one paper wave, then crease wave, piers and beacon back into the original fish mark.
